notes: Second isnad after the matn «وحدثنيه» carries the same saying: two groups of its own. The shared names «كلاهما عن إسرائيل، عن أبي إسحاق، عن البراء» are written into each branch and shared_tail is null, because a report-level tail would also attach to the first isnad, which already ends at البراء
Remarks on wording («وقال في حديثه من رواية عثمان بن عمر») are left out
